description.en: English tenses - present, past and future forms with time markers and common errors asked in Assam competitive exams.
description.as: ইংৰাজী কাল (Tenses) — বৰ্তমান, অতীত আৰু ভৱিষ্যত কালৰ ৰূপ, সময়সূচক শব্দ আৰু অসম প্ৰতিযোগিতামূলক পৰীক্ষাত অহা সাধাৰণ ভুল।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She ___ to school every day.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She ___ to school every day.'

a.en: 'Every day' shows a habit, so we use the simple present. With 'she' we add 's/es'.
a.as: 'every day' অভ্যাস বুজায়, গতিকে simple present হয়। 'she'ৰ লগত 's/es' যোগ হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (goes). 'Every day' marks a habitual action, which takes the simple present; with the third-person singular 'she' the verb adds -s/-es. 'Go' (B) breaks subject-verb agreement, while 'went' (C) is past and 'has gone' (D) is present perfect, neither of which fits a routine.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (goes)। 'every day' অভ্যাসগত কাৰ্য সূচায়, যাৰ বাবে simple present লাগে; তৃতীয় পুৰুষ একবচন 'she'ৰ লগত ক্ৰিয়াত -s/-es যোগ হয়। 'go' (B) কৰ্তা-ক্ৰিয়া মিল নাখায়, 'went' (C) অতীত আৰু 'has gone' (D) present perfect — নিয়মীয়া কামৰ বাবে দুয়োটা অনুপযুক্ত।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The sun ___ in the east.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The sun ___ in the east.'

a.en: A universal truth is always in the simple present tense.
a.as: সৰ্বকালীন সত্য সদায় simple present tenseত থাকে।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (rises). A universal truth is always stated in the simple present, and the third-person subject 'the sun' takes 'rises'. 'Rise' (B) lacks the -s, 'rose' (C) is past, and 'has risen' (D) is present perfect — none of them expresses a timeless fact.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (rises)। সৰ্বকালীন সত্য সদায় simple presentত প্ৰকাশ কৰা হয়, আৰু তৃতীয় পুৰুষ কৰ্তা 'the sun'ৰ লগত 'rises' হয়। 'rise' (B)ত -s নাই, 'rose' (C) অতীত, 'has risen' (D) present perfect — এটাও কালজয়ী সত্য প্ৰকাশ নকৰে।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'Look! It ___ (rain) now.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'Look! It ___ (rain) now.'

a.en: An action happening now uses the present continuous (is + ing).
a.as: এতিয়া চলি থকা কাৰ্য present continuous (is + ing)ত হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (is raining). 'Look!' and 'now' show an action happening at this moment, so the present continuous (is/am/are + verb-ing) is required. 'Rains' (B) is habitual, 'rained' (C) is past, and 'has rained' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (is raining)। 'Look!' আৰু 'now' এই মুহূৰ্তত চলি থকা কাৰ্য দেখুৱায়, গতিকে present continuous (is/am/are + verb-ing) লাগে। 'rains' (B) অভ্যাসগত, 'rained' (C) অতীত, 'has rained' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She ___ (cook) dinner at present.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She ___ (cook) dinner at present.'

a.en: 'At present' indicates an action going on now, so present continuous.
a.as: 'at present' এতিয়া চলি থকা কাৰ্য বুজায়, গতিকে present continuous।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (is cooking). 'At present' means right now, so the present continuous is used. 'Cooks' (B) is a routine, 'cooked' (C) is past, and 'has cooked' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (is cooking)। 'at present' অৰ্থাৎ এতিয়া, গতিকে present continuous হয়। 'cooks' (B) নিয়মীয়া কাম, 'cooked' (C) অতীত, 'has cooked' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (finish) my homework just now.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (finish) my homework just now.'

a.en: 'Just' suggests a recently completed action, so we use the present perfect.
a.as: 'just'য়ে শেহতীয়াকৈ সম্পন্ন কাৰ্য বুজায়, গতিকে present perfect হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (have finished). 'Just' indicates an action completed very recently whose result is still relevant, so the present perfect (have/has + past participle) is used. 'Finish' (B) is present simple, 'finished' (C) is simple past, and 'was finishing' (D) is past continuous.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (have finished)। 'just' এ শেহতীয়াকৈ সম্পন্ন হোৱা কাৰ্য বুজায় যাৰ ফল এতিয়াও প্ৰাসংগিক, গতিকে present perfect (have/has + past participle) হয়। 'finish' (B) simple present, 'finished' (C) simple past, 'was finishing' (D) past continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (live) here since 2005.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He ___ (live) here since 2005.'

a.en: 'Since + a point of time' with an action still continuing takes the present perfect.
a.as: 'since + সময়ৰ বিন্দু' থাকিলে এতিয়াও চলি থকা কাৰ্য present perfect হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (has lived). 'Since + a point of time' with an action that continues to the present takes the present perfect. 'Lives' (B) and 'is living' (C) are present forms that ignore the starting point, and 'lived' (D) is simple past.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (has lived)। 'since + সময়ৰ বিন্দু' আৰু বৰ্তমানলৈকে চলি থকা কাৰ্যৰ লগত present perfect হয়। 'lives' (B) আৰু 'is living' (C) বৰ্তমান ৰূপ যিয়ে আৰম্ভণিৰ সময় উপেক্ষা কৰে, 'lived' (D) simple past।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'They ___ (play) cricket for two hours.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'They ___ (play) cricket for two hours.'

a.en: 'For + a period' with an action started in the past and still going on takes the present perfect continuous.
a.as: 'for + সময়ৰ দৈৰ্ঘ্য' আৰু অতীতত আৰম্ভ হৈ এতিয়াও চলি থকা কাৰ্য present perfect continuous হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (have been playing). 'For + a period' with an action that began in the past and is still going on takes the present perfect continuous. 'Are playing' (B) lacks the duration, 'played' (C) is past, and 'play' (D) is present simple.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (have been playing)। 'for + সময়ৰ দৈৰ্ঘ্য' আৰু অতীতত আৰম্ভ হৈ এতিয়াও চলি থকা কাৰ্যত present perfect continuous হয়। 'are playing' (B)ত সময়ৰ দৈৰ্ঘ্য নাই, 'played' (C) অতীত, 'play' (D) simple present।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (visit) my uncle last week.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (visit) my uncle last week.'

a.en: 'Last week' is a finished past time, so we use the simple past.
a.as: 'last week' সম্পন্ন অতীত সময়, গতিকে simple past হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (visited). 'Last week' is a finished past time, so the simple past is required. 'Have visited' (B) is present perfect and cannot be used with a definite past time, 'visit' (C) is present, and 'was visiting' (D) is past continuous.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (visited)। 'last week' সম্পন্ন অতীত সময়, গতিকে simple past লাগে। 'have visited' (B) present perfect, নিৰ্দিষ্ট অতীত সময়ৰ লগত নহয়; 'visit' (C) বৰ্তমান, 'was visiting' (D) past continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The baby ___ (cry) when I came in.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The baby ___ (cry) when I came in.'

a.en: An action going on when another past action happened uses the past continuous.
a.as: অতীতৰ আন কাৰ্যৰ সময়ত চলি থকা কাৰ্য past continuous হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (was crying). An action that was going on when another past action happened ('came in') is expressed by the past continuous. 'Cried' (B) is simple past, 'cries' (C) is present, and 'has cried' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (was crying)। অতীতৰ আন কাৰ্য ('came in') ঘটাৰ সময়ত চলি থকা কাৰ্য past continuousত হয়। 'cried' (B) simple past, 'cries' (C) বৰ্তমান, 'has cried' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The train ___ (leave) before we reached the station.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The train ___ (leave) before we reached the station.'

a.en: An action completed before another past action takes the past perfect.
a.as: অতীতৰ আন কাৰ্যৰ আগত সম্পন্ন হোৱা কাৰ্য past perfect হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (had left). The train's departure happened before another past action ('reached'), so the earlier action takes the past perfect. 'Left' (B) and 'was leaving' (D) are past forms that do not show the sequence, and 'leaves' (C) is present.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (had left)। ৰেলখনৰ প্ৰস্থান আন এটা অতীত কাৰ্য ('reached')ৰ আগত হৈছিল, গতিকে আগৰ কাৰ্যটো past perfectত হয়। 'left' (B) আৰু 'was leaving' (D)ই ক্ৰম দেখুৱাই নাই, 'leaves' (C) বৰ্তমান।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (work) for three hours before the boss came.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He ___ (work) for three hours before the boss came.'

a.en: An action continuing up to a past point uses the past perfect continuous.
a.as: অতীতৰ কোনো সময়লৈকে চলি থকা কাৰ্য past perfect continuous হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (had been working). An action that continued up to a point in the past ('before the boss came') takes the past perfect continuous. 'Has been working' (B) is present perfect continuous, 'was working' (C) ignores the duration, and 'worked' (D) is simple past.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (had been working)। অতীতৰ এটা বিন্দুলৈকে ('before the boss came') চলি থকা কাৰ্য past perfect continuousত হয়। 'has been working' (B) present perfect continuous, 'was working' (C)ত দৈৰ্ঘ্য নাই, 'worked' (D) simple past।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (call) you tomorrow.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (call) you tomorrow.'

a.en: 'Tomorrow' indicates a future action, so we use 'will + verb'.
a.as: 'tomorrow' ভৱিষ্যত বুজায়, গতিকে 'will + verb' হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (will call). 'Tomorrow' points to future time, so 'will + base verb' is used. 'Call' (B) is present, 'called' (C) is past, and 'have called' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (will call)। 'tomorrow' ভৱিষ্যত সময়লৈ নিৰ্দেশ কৰে, গতিকে 'will + মূল ক্ৰিয়া' হয়। 'call' (B) বৰ্তমান, 'called' (C) অতীত, 'have called' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She ___ (finish) the work by evening.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She ___ (finish) the work by evening.'

a.en: 'By + a future time' showing completion takes the future perfect.
a.as: 'by + ভৱিষ্যত সময়'ত সম্পন্নতা বুজালে future perfect হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (will have finished). 'By + a future time' showing completion before that time takes the future perfect. 'Will finish' (B) does not show completion, 'finishes' (C) is present, and 'has finished' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (will have finished)। 'by + ভৱিষ্যত সময়'ত সেই সময়ৰ আগতে সম্পন্নতা বুজালে future perfect হয়। 'will finish' (B)ই সম্পন্নতা দেখুৱাই নাই, 'finishes' (C) বৰ্তমান, 'has finished' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'This time next week I ___ (travel) to Delhi.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'This time next week I ___ (travel) to Delhi.'

a.en: An action in progress at a certain future time uses the future continuous.
a.as: ভৱিষ্যতৰ নিৰ্দিষ্ট সময়ত চলি থকা কাৰ্য future continuous হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (will be travelling). An action that will be in progress at a certain future point ('this time next week') takes the future continuous. 'Will travel' (B) is a simple future fact, 'am travelling' (C) is present continuous, and 'have travelled' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (will be travelling)। ভৱিষ্যতৰ নিৰ্দিষ্ট সময়ত ('this time next week') চলি থাকিবলগীয়া কাৰ্য future continuousত হয়। 'will travel' (B) সৰল ভৱিষ্যত, 'am travelling' (C) present continuous, 'have travelled' (D) present perfect।

q.en: 'Since morning' is a marker mainly used with which tense?
q.as: 'since morning' মূলত কোন কালৰ লগত ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?

a.en: 'Since + a starting point' is typical of the present perfect / present perfect continuous tense.
a.as: 'since + আৰম্ভণি বিন্দু' present perfect / present perfect continuous ৰ বৈশিষ্ট্যপূৰ্ণ।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (Present perfect continuous). 'Since morning' gives a starting point from which an action continues to now, which is the typical use of the present perfect / present perfect continuous. Simple past (B), past perfect (C) and future simple (D) do not pair with 'since' in this way.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (Present perfect continuous)। 'since morning' এনে এটা আৰম্ভণি বিন্দু দিয়ে যাৰপৰা কাৰ্য এতিয়ালৈকে চলি থাকে, যি present perfect / present perfect continuousৰ বৈশিষ্ট্য। Simple past (B), past perfect (C), future simple (D)ৰ লগত 'since' এনে ধৰণে নালাগে।

q.en: 'Yesterday' is a marker mainly used with which tense?
q.as: 'yesterday' মূলত কোন কালৰ লগত ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?

a.en: 'Yesterday' points to a finished past time, so the simple past is used.
a.as: 'yesterday' সম্পন্ন অতীত সময়লৈ নিৰ্দেশ কৰে, গতিকে simple past হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (Simple past). 'Yesterday' refers to a finished past time, so the simple past is used. Simple present (B), future perfect (C) and present continuous (D) cannot describe a completed past day.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (Simple past)। 'yesterday' সম্পন্ন অতীত সময়লৈ নিৰ্দেশ কৰে, গতিকে simple past হয়। Simple present (B), future perfect (C), present continuous (D)ই পাৰ হৈ যোৱা কাল বুজাব নোৱাৰে।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I met him two days ___.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I met him two days ___.'

a.en: 'Ago' is used with a past time and the simple past tense.
a.as: 'ago' অতীত সময় আৰু simple past tenseৰ লগত ব্যৱহাৰ হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (ago). 'Ago' is used with a past time expression and the simple past ('two days ago'). 'Before' (B) is used for an earlier past event, 'since' (C) needs a starting point with a perfect tense, and 'for' (D) takes a duration.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (ago)। 'ago' অতীত সময়ৰ প্ৰকাশ আৰু simple pastৰ লগত ব্যৱহাৰ হয় ('two days ago')। 'before' (B) আগৰ অতীত ঘটনাৰ বাবে, 'since' (C)ৰ লগত perfect কালত আৰম্ভণি বিন্দু লাগে, 'for' (D) সময়ৰ দৈৰ্ঘ্য লয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She has been working here ___ 2019.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She has been working here ___ 2019.'

a.en: A point of time (2019) takes 'since' in the present perfect.
a.as: সময়ৰ বিন্দু (২০১৯) present perfectত 'since' লয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (since). 'Since' is used before a point of time (2019) in a perfect tense. 'For' (B) takes a period, 'from' (C) would need a 'to', and 'ago' (D) is used with the simple past.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (since)। perfect কালত সময়ৰ বিন্দু (২০১৯)ৰ আগত 'since' ব্যৱহাৰ হয়। 'for' (B) সময়ৰ দৈৰ্ঘ্য লয়, 'from' (C)ৰ লগত 'to' লাগে, 'ago' (D) simple pastৰ লগত হয়।

q.en: Which verb does not take the continuous form?
q.as: কোনটো ক্রিয়া continuous ৰূপ নলয়?

a.en: 'Know' is a stative verb (state, not action), so we say 'I know', not 'I am knowing'.
a.as: 'know' এটা stative (অৱস্থাবোধক) ক্রিয়া; 'I know' হয়, 'I am knowing' নহয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (know). 'Know' is a stative verb expressing a state, not an action, so it is not used in the continuous form; we say 'I know', not 'I am knowing'. 'Run' (B), 'sing' (C) and 'dance' (D) are action verbs and take the continuous form freely.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (know)। 'know' এটা stative (অৱস্থাবোধক) ক্ৰিয়া, কাৰ্য নহয়, গতিকে continuous ৰূপত ব্যৱহাৰ নহয়; 'I know' হয়, 'I am knowing' নহয়। 'run' (B), 'sing' (C), 'dance' (D) কাৰ্যসূচক ক্ৰিয়া, continuous ৰূপ লয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (know) the answer to this question.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He ___ (know) the answer to this question.'

a.en: Stative verbs like 'know' are not used in the continuous form.
a.as: 'know'ৰ দৰে stative ক্রিয়া continuous ৰূপত নহয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (knows). The stative verb 'know' is not used in the continuous form, so the simple present with the third-person -s is correct. 'Is knowing' (B) and 'has been knowing' (C) wrongly use continuous forms, and 'knew' (D) is past.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (knows)। stative ক্ৰিয়া 'know' continuous ৰূপত নহয়, গতিকে তৃতীয় পুৰুষৰ -s সহ simple present শুদ্ধ। 'is knowing' (B) আৰু 'has been knowing' (C)য়ে ভুলভাৱে continuous ৰূপ ব্যৱহাৰ কৰিছে, 'knew' (D) অতীত।

q.en: 'Every day' is a marker mainly used with which tense?
q.as: 'every day' মূলত কোন কালৰ লগত ব্যৱহাৰ হয়?

a.en: 'Every day' shows a routine, so the simple present tense is used.
a.as: 'every day' নিয়মীয়া কাম বুজায়, গতিকে simple present হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (Simple present). 'Every day' marks a routine or habit, which is expressed in the simple present. Past perfect (B), future continuous (C) and present perfect continuous (D) do not express habitual actions.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (Simple present)। 'every day' নিয়মীয়া অভ্যাস সূচায়, যি simple presentত প্ৰকাশ হয়। Past perfect (B), future continuous (C), present perfect continuous (D)ই অভ্যাসগত কাৰ্য প্ৰকাশ নকৰে।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The earth ___ round the sun.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The earth ___ round the sun.'

a.en: Scientific truths are expressed in the simple present tense.
a.as: বৈজ্ঞানিক সত্য simple present tenseত প্ৰকাশ হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (moves). A scientific truth is expressed in the simple present, and 'the earth' takes 'moves'. 'Moved' (B) is past, 'is moving' (C) is present continuous, and 'has moved' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (moves)। বৈজ্ঞানিক সত্য simple presentত প্ৰকাশ হয়, আৰু 'the earth'ৰ লগত 'moves' হয়। 'moved' (B) অতীত, 'is moving' (C) present continuous, 'has moved' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (see) him yesterday.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (see) him yesterday.'

a.en: 'Yesterday' takes the simple past. The past of 'see' is 'saw'.
a.as: 'yesterday' simple past হয়। 'see'ৰ অতীত 'saw'।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (saw). 'Yesterday' is a definite past time, so the simple past is used; the past form of 'see' is 'saw'. 'Seen' (B) is a past participle and cannot stand alone, 'have seen' (C) is present perfect, and 'see' (D) is present.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (saw)। 'yesterday' নিৰ্দিষ্ট অতীত সময়, গতিকে simple past হয়; 'see'ৰ অতীত ৰূপ 'saw'। 'seen' (B) past participle, অকলে নহয়; 'have seen' (C) present perfect, 'see' (D) বৰ্তমান।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She ___ (not, go) to Guwahati last month.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She ___ (not, go) to Guwahati last month.'

a.en: The negative of the simple past is made with 'did not + base verb'.
a.as: simple pastৰ নেতিবাচক ৰূপ 'did not + মূল ক্রিয়া'ৰে হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (did not go). The negative of the simple past is 'did not + base verb', and 'last month' confirms the simple past. 'Does not go' (B) is present, 'has not gone' (C) is present perfect, and 'was not going' (D) is past continuous.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (did not go)। simple pastৰ নেতিবাচক ৰূপ 'did not + মূল ক্ৰিয়া', আৰু 'last month'এ simple past নিশ্চিত কৰে। 'does not go' (B) বৰ্তমান, 'has not gone' (C) present perfect, 'was not going' (D) past continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: '___ you ___ (eat) your breakfast yet?'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: '___ you ___ (eat) your breakfast yet?'

a.en: 'Yet' is used with the present perfect: 'Have + past participle'.
a.as: 'yet' present perfectৰ লগত হয়: 'Have + past participle'।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (Have ... eaten). 'Yet' is a marker of the present perfect, which is formed with 'have/has + past participle'. 'Did ... ate' (B) and 'Do ... ate' (C) wrongly use the past form after 'did/do', and 'Are ... eating' (D) is present continuous.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (Have ... eaten)। 'yet' present perfectৰ চিহ্ন, যি 'have/has + past participle'ৰে গঠিত। 'Did ... ate' (B) আৰু 'Do ... ate' (C)য়ে 'did/do'ৰ পিছত ভুলভাৱে অতীত ৰূপ দিছে, 'Are ... eating' (D) present continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (read) a book when the lights went out.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He ___ (read) a book when the lights went out.'

a.en: An action in progress in the past when another action interrupted it uses the past continuous.
a.as: অতীতত চলি থকা কাৰ্যত আন কাৰ্যই বাধা দিলে past continuous হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (was reading). An action in progress in the past that is interrupted by another past action ('went out') takes the past continuous. 'Read' (B) is simple past, 'reads' (C) is present, and 'had read' (D) is past perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (was reading)। অতীতত চলি থকা কাৰ্যত আন এটা অতীত কাৰ্য ('went out')ই বাধা দিলে past continuous হয়। 'read' (B) simple past, 'reads' (C) বৰ্তমান, 'had read' (D) past perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'When I reached the hall, he ___ (already, leave).'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'When I reached the hall, he ___ (already, leave).'

a.en: An action that happened before another past action is in the past perfect.
a.as: অতীতৰ আন কাৰ্যৰ আগত হোৱা কাৰ্য past perfect হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (had already left). An action that had already happened before another past action ('reached') is in the past perfect, and 'already' fits naturally there. 'Has already left' (B) is present perfect, 'already leaves' (C) is present, and 'was already leaving' (D) is past continuous.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (had already left)। আন এটা অতীত কাৰ্য ('reached')ৰ আগতেই হোৱা কাৰ্য past perfectত হয়, আৰু 'already' তাৰ লগত স্বাভাৱিকভাৱে খাপ খায়। 'has already left' (B) present perfect, 'already leaves' (C) বৰ্তমান, 'was already leaving' (D) past continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'By next year I ___ (graduate).'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'By next year I ___ (graduate).'

a.en: 'By + future time' takes the future perfect tense.
a.as: 'by + ভৱিষ্যত সময়'ত future perfect হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (will have graduated). 'By + a future time' shows an action completed before that future point and takes the future perfect. 'Will graduate' (B) is simple future, 'graduate' (C) is present, and 'have graduated' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (will have graduated)। 'by + ভৱিষ্যত সময়'য়ে সেই সময়ৰ আগতে সম্পন্ন হোৱা কাৰ্য বুজায় আৰু future perfect লয়। 'will graduate' (B) simple future, 'graduate' (C) বৰ্তমান, 'have graduated' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'They ___ (build) this bridge in 1990.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'They ___ (build) this bridge in 1990.'

a.en: 'In 1990' is a finished past time, so we use the simple past 'built'.
a.as: 'in 1990' সম্পন্ন অতীত সময়, গতিকে simple past 'built' হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (built). 'In 1990' is a finished past time, so the simple past 'built' is used. 'Build' (B) is present, 'have built' (C) is present perfect and cannot take a definite past date, and 'were building' (D) is past continuous.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (built)। 'in 1990' সম্পন্ন অতীত সময়, গতিকে simple past 'built' হয়। 'build' (B) বৰ্তমান, 'have built' (C) present perfect আৰু নিৰ্দিষ্ট অতীত তাৰিখৰ লগত নহয়, 'were building' (D) past continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The movie ___ (start) before we reached the hall.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The movie ___ (start) before we reached the hall.'

a.en: The earlier of two past actions is in the past perfect.
a.as: দুটা অতীত কাৰ্যৰ আগত হোৱাটো past perfect হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (had started). Of two past actions, the earlier one ('start' before 'reached') takes the past perfect. 'Started' (B) is simple past, 'starts' (C) is present, and 'has started' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (had started)। দুটা অতীত কাৰ্যৰ আগত হোৱাটো ('reached'ৰ আগতে 'start') past perfectত হয়। 'started' (B) simple past, 'starts' (C) বৰ্তমান, 'has started' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (write) this letter since morning.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (write) this letter since morning.'

a.en: 'Since morning' with an action still going on takes the present perfect continuous.
a.as: 'since morning' আৰু এতিয়াও চলি থকা কাৰ্য present perfect continuous হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (have been writing). 'Since morning' with an action still going on takes the present perfect continuous. 'Am writing' (B) misses the duration, 'wrote' (C) is past, and 'write' (D) is present simple.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (have been writing)। 'since morning' আৰু এতিয়াও চলি থকা কাৰ্যত present perfect continuous হয়। 'am writing' (B)ত দৈৰ্ঘ্য নাই, 'wrote' (C) অতীত, 'write' (D) simple present।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'It ___ (not, rain) now.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'It ___ (not, rain) now.'

a.en: The negative of the present continuous is 'is/am/are + not + ing'.
a.as: present continuousৰ নেতিবাচক ৰূপ 'is/am/are + not + ing'।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (is not raining). 'Now' shows an action in progress, so the present continuous negative is 'is/am/are + not + verb-ing'. 'Does not raining' (B) mixes 'does' with -ing, 'not raining' (C) lacks an auxiliary, and 'has not raining' (D) is a malformed form.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (is not raining)। 'now' চলি থকা কাৰ্য দেখুৱায়, গতিকে present continuousৰ নেতিবাচক ৰূপ 'is/am/are + not + verb-ing'। 'does not raining' (B)ত 'does'ৰ লগত -ing ভুল, 'not raining' (C)ত সহায়ক ক্ৰিয়া নাই, 'has not raining' (D) ভুল গঠন।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'How long ___ you ___ (learn) English?'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'How long ___ you ___ (learn) English?'

a.en: 'How long' asks about duration up to now, so the present perfect continuous is used.
a.as: 'how long'য়ে এতিয়ালৈকে সময় বিচাৰে, গতিকে present perfect continuous হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (have ... been learning). 'How long' asks about a duration continuing up to now, which takes the present perfect continuous. 'Are ... learning' (B) is present continuous, 'do ... learn' (C) is simple present, and 'did ... learn' (D) is simple past.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (have ... been learning)। 'how long'য়ে এতিয়ালৈকে চলি থকা সময়ৰ দৈৰ্ঘ্য সোধে, গতিকে present perfect continuous হয়। 'are ... learning' (B) present continuous, 'do ... learn' (C) simple present, 'did ... learn' (D) simple past।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'My brother ___ (play) cricket every evening.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'My brother ___ (play) cricket every evening.'

a.en: A routine with a third-person subject takes 'plays' (adds s/es).
a.as: তৃতীয় পুৰুষৰ নিয়মীয়া কামত 'plays' (s/es যোগ) হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (plays). 'Every evening' shows a routine and the third-person subject 'my brother' requires -s, so 'plays' is correct. 'Play' (B) breaks agreement, 'is playing' (C) is present continuous, and 'has played' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (plays)। 'every evening' নিয়মীয়া কাম দেখুৱায় আৰু তৃতীয় পুৰুষ কৰ্তা 'my brother'ৰ বাবে -s লাগে, গতিকে 'plays' শুদ্ধ। 'play' (B)ত কৰ্তা-ক্ৰিয়া মিল নাই, 'is playing' (C) present continuous, 'has played' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She ___ (wash) her clothes at present.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She ___ (wash) her clothes at present.'

a.en: 'At present' shows an action happening now, so present continuous.
a.as: 'at present' এতিয়া হোৱা কাৰ্য দেখুৱায়, গতিকে present continuous।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (is washing). 'At present' means now, so the present continuous is used. 'Washes' (B) is habitual, 'washed' (C) is past, and 'will wash' (D) is future.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (is washing)। 'at present' অৰ্থাৎ এতিয়া, গতিকে present continuous হয়। 'washes' (B) অভ্যাসগত, 'washed' (C) অতীত, 'will wash' (D) ভৱিষ্যত।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The train ___ at 6 pm every day.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The train ___ at 6 pm every day.'

a.en: Fixed timetables and schedules are expressed in the simple present.
a.as: নিৰ্ধাৰিত সময়সূচী simple present tenseত প্ৰকাশ হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (leaves). Fixed timetables and schedules are expressed in the simple present. 'Is leaving' (B) is present continuous, 'has left' (C) is present perfect, and 'left' (D) is past.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (leaves)। নিৰ্ধাৰিত সময়সূচী simple presentত প্ৰকাশ কৰা হয়। 'is leaving' (B) present continuous, 'has left' (C) present perfect, 'left' (D) অতীত।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'They ___ (not, watch) TV last night.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'They ___ (not, watch) TV last night.'

a.en: 'Last night' takes the simple past negative: 'did not + watch'.
a.as: 'last night' simple past নেতিবাচক হয়: 'did not + watch'।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (did not watch). 'Last night' takes the simple past negative 'did not + base verb'. 'Were not watch' (B) mixes 'were' with the base form, 'do not watch' (C) is present, and 'have not watched' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (did not watch)। 'last night'এ simple past নেতিবাচক 'did not + মূল ক্ৰিয়া' লয়। 'were not watch' (B)ত 'were'ৰ লগত মূল ক্ৰিয়া ভুল, 'do not watch' (C) বৰ্তমান, 'have not watched' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'We ___ (live) in Assam for ten years now.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'We ___ (live) in Assam for ten years now.'

a.en: 'For + period + now' shows an action continuing to the present, so the present perfect is used.
a.as: 'for + সময় + now' বৰ্তমানলৈকে চলি থকা কাৰ্য দেখুৱায়, গতিকে present perfect হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (have lived). 'For + a period + now' shows a state continuing up to the present, so the present perfect is used. 'Live' (B) is present simple, 'lived' (C) is past, and 'are living' (D) is present continuous.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (have lived)। 'for + সময় + now' বৰ্তমানলৈকে চলি থকা অৱস্থা দেখুৱায়, গতিকে present perfect হয়। 'live' (B) simple present, 'lived' (C) অতীত, 'are living' (D) present continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'Look! The boy ___ (drown)!'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'Look! The boy ___ (drown)!'

a.en: 'Look!' points to an action happening at this moment, so present continuous.
a.as: 'look!' এতিয়া হোৱা কাৰ্য নিৰ্দেশ কৰে, গতিকে present continuous।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (is drowning). 'Look!' points to an action happening at this very moment, so the present continuous is needed. 'Drowns' (B) is habitual, 'drowned' (C) is past, and 'has drowned' (D) is present perfect, which would suggest he is already dead.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (is drowning)। 'Look!' এই মুহূৰ্ততে ঘটি থকা কাৰ্যলৈ নিৰ্দেশ কৰে, গতিকে present continuous লাগে। 'drowns' (B) অভ্যাসগত, 'drowned' (C) অতীত, 'has drowned' (D) present perfect, যিয়ে তেওঁ ইতিমধ্যে মৃত বুলি বুজাব পাৰে।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (hear) a strange noise just now.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (hear) a strange noise just now.'

a.en: 'Just now' means a moment ago, so the simple past 'heard' is used.
a.as: 'just now' অৰ্থাৎ অলপ আগতে, গতিকে simple past 'heard' হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (heard). 'Just now' means a moment ago and takes the simple past. 'Hear' (B) is present, 'am hearing' (C) wrongly uses a stative verb in the continuous, and 'have been hearing' (D) is present perfect continuous.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (heard)। 'just now' অৰ্থাৎ অলপ আগতে, গতিকে simple past হয়। 'hear' (B) বৰ্তমান, 'am hearing' (C)য়ে stative ক্ৰিয়া ভুলভাৱে continuousত ব্যৱহাৰ কৰিছে, 'have been hearing' (D) present perfect continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.'

a.en: A scientific fact is in the simple present tense.
a.as: বৈজ্ঞানিক তথ্য simple present tenseত হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (boils). A scientific fact is stated in the simple present. 'Boiled' (B) is past, 'is boiling' (C) is present continuous describing a particular moment, and 'has boiled' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (boils)। বৈজ্ঞানিক তথ্য simple presentত প্ৰকাশ হয়। 'boiled' (B) অতীত, 'is boiling' (C) এটা নিৰ্দিষ্ট মুহূৰ্তৰ present continuous, 'has boiled' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (sleep) when the phone rang.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He ___ (sleep) when the phone rang.'

a.en: An action in progress in the past when interrupted uses the past continuous.
a.as: অতীতত চলি থকা কাৰ্যত বাধা পৰিলে past continuous হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (was sleeping). An action in progress in the past when another action interrupted it ('the phone rang') takes the past continuous. 'Slept' (B) is simple past, 'sleeps' (C) is present, and 'has slept' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (was sleeping)। অতীতত চলি থকা কাৰ্যত আন কাৰ্য ('the phone rang')ই বাধা দিলে past continuous হয়। 'slept' (B) simple past, 'sleeps' (C) বৰ্তমান, 'has slept' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She has been ill ___ Monday.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She has been ill ___ Monday.'

a.en: A point of time (Monday) takes 'since' in the present perfect.
a.as: সময়ৰ বিন্দু (সোমবাৰ) present perfectত 'since' লয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (since). A point of time (Monday) is preceded by 'since' in a perfect tense. 'For' (B) takes a period, 'from' (C) would need a 'to', and 'to' (D) cannot follow 'has been ill' here.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (since)। perfect কালত সময়ৰ বিন্দু (সোমবাৰ)ৰ আগত 'since' হয়। 'for' (B) সময়ৰ দৈৰ্ঘ্য লয়, 'from' (C)ৰ লগত 'to' লাগে, 'to' (D) ইয়াত 'has been ill'ৰ পিছত নহয়।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'By the time we arrived, they ___ (eat) everything.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'By the time we arrived, they ___ (eat) everything.'

a.en: 'By the time + past' requires the past perfect for the earlier action.
a.as: 'by the time + অতীত'ত আগৰ কাৰ্যৰ বাবে past perfect লাগে।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (had eaten). 'By the time + past' requires the past perfect for the action that was completed earlier. 'Ate' (B) is simple past, 'have eaten' (C) is present perfect, and 'were eating' (D) is past continuous, which does not show completion.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (had eaten)। 'by the time + অতীত'ত আগতে সম্পন্ন হোৱা কাৰ্যৰ বাবে past perfect লাগে। 'ate' (B) simple past, 'have eaten' (C) present perfect, 'were eating' (D) past continuous — যিয়ে সম্পন্নতা দেখুৱাই নাই।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'This time tomorrow, I ___ (fly) over the clouds.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'This time tomorrow, I ___ (fly) over the clouds.'

a.en: 'This time tomorrow' shows an action in progress at a future time, so the future continuous.
a.as: 'this time tomorrow' ভৱিষ্যতত চলি থকা কাৰ্য দেখুৱায়, গতিকে future continuous।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (will be flying). An action in progress at a specified future time ('this time tomorrow') takes the future continuous. 'Will fly' (B) is simple future, 'am flying' (C) is present continuous, and 'flew' (D) is past.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (will be flying)। নিৰ্দিষ্ট ভৱিষ্যত সময়ত ('this time tomorrow') চলি থকা কাৰ্য future continuousত হয়। 'will fly' (B) simple future, 'am flying' (C) present continuous, 'flew' (D) অতীত।

q.en: Fill in the blank: '___ you ever ___ (see) the Taj Mahal?'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: '___ you ever ___ (see) the Taj Mahal?'

a.en: 'Ever' is used with the present perfect: 'Have + past participle'.
a.as: 'ever' present perfectৰ লগত হয়: 'Have + past participle'।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (Have ... seen). 'Ever' is used with the present perfect, formed as 'have/has + past participle'. 'Did ... saw' (B) and 'Do ... saw' (C) wrongly use the past form after 'did/do', and 'Are ... seeing' (D) is present continuous.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (Have ... seen)। 'ever' present perfectৰ লগত হয়, গঠন 'have/has + past participle'। 'Did ... saw' (B) আৰু 'Do ... saw' (C)য়ে 'did/do'ৰ পিছত ভুলভাৱে অতীত ৰূপ দিছে, 'Are ... seeing' (D) present continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'They ___ (build) the road for several months.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'They ___ (build) the road for several months.'

a.en: 'For + period' with an unfinished ongoing action takes the present perfect continuous.
a.as: 'for + সময়' আৰু সমাপ্ত নোহোৱা চলি থকা কাৰ্য present perfect continuous হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (have been building). 'For + a period' with an unfinished, ongoing action takes the present perfect continuous. 'Build' (B) is present simple, 'built' (C) is past, and 'had built' (D) is past perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (have been building)। 'for + সময়' আৰু সমাপ্ত নোহোৱা চলি থকা কাৰ্যত present perfect continuous হয়। 'build' (B) simple present, 'built' (C) অতীত, 'had built' (D) past perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I will call you as soon as I ___ (reach) home.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I will call you as soon as I ___ (reach) home.'

a.en: After 'as soon as / when / if' in a future sentence we use the present tense, not 'will'.
a.as: 'as soon as / when / if'ৰ পিছত ভৱিষ্যত বুজালেও present tense হয়, 'will' নহয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (reach). After 'as soon as / when / if' in a future sentence, the present tense is used, not 'will'. 'Will reach' (B) is a common error, 'reached' (C) is past, and 'have reached' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (reach)। ভৱিষ্যতৰ বাক্যত 'as soon as / when / if'ৰ পিছত 'will' নহয়, present tense হয়। 'will reach' (B) সাধাৰণ ভুল, 'reached' (C) অতীত, 'have reached' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we will cancel the match.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we will cancel the match.'

a.en: In the first conditional, the 'if' clause takes the simple present and the main clause takes 'will'.
a.as: first conditionalত 'if' খণ্ডত simple present আৰু মূল বাক্যত 'will' হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (rains). In the first conditional, the 'if' clause takes the simple present and the main clause takes 'will'. 'Will rain' (B) is a common error, 'rained' (C) is past, and 'would rain' (D) belongs to the second conditional.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (rains)। first conditionalত 'if' খণ্ডত simple present আৰু মূল বাক্যত 'will' হয়। 'will rain' (B) সাধাৰণ ভুল, 'rained' (C) অতীত, 'would rain' (D) second conditionalৰ।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The earth ___ (be) round.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The earth ___ (be) round.'

a.en: A universal truth always stays in the simple present.
a.as: সাৰ্বজনীন সত্য সদায় simple present tenseত থাকে।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (is). A universal truth always stays in the simple present. 'Was' (B) is past, 'has been' (C) is present perfect, and 'will be' (D) is future.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (is)। সাৰ্বজনীন সত্য সদায় simple presentত থাকে। 'was' (B) অতীত, 'has been' (C) present perfect, 'will be' (D) ভৱিষ্যত।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He speaks as if he ___ everything.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He speaks as if he ___ everything.'

a.en: After 'as if / as though' we use a past tense for an unreal or imaginary comparison.
a.as: 'as if / as though'ৰ পিছত অবাস্তৱ বা কল্পনামূলক তুলনাত past tense হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (knew). After 'as if / as though', an unreal or imaginary comparison takes a past tense. 'Knows' (B) and 'know' (C) are present forms, and 'is knowing' (D) wrongly puts a stative verb in the continuous.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (knew)। 'as if / as though'ৰ পিছত অবাস্তৱ বা কল্পনামূলক তুলনাত past tense হয়। 'knows' (B) আৰু 'know' (C) বৰ্তমান ৰূপ, 'is knowing' (D)য়ে stative ক্ৰিয়া ভুলভাৱে continuousত দিছে।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I wish I ___ (be) a bird.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I wish I ___ (be) a bird.'

a.en: After 'wish' we use the subjunctive past 'were' for unreal wishes.
a.as: 'wish'ৰ পিছত অবাস্তৱ ইচ্ছাত subjunctive 'were' হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (were). After 'wish', an unreal present wish takes the subjunctive past 'were' for all subjects. 'Am' (B) is present, 'was' (C) is not used in this subjunctive, and 'be' (D) is the base form.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (were)। 'wish'ৰ পিছত বৰ্তমানৰ অবাস্তৱ ইচ্ছাত সকলো কৰ্তাৰ বাবে subjunctive past 'were' হয়। 'am' (B) বৰ্তমান, 'was' (C) এই subjunctiveত নহয়, 'be' (D) মূল ৰূপ।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'It is high time we ___ (go) home.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'It is high time we ___ (go) home.'

a.en: After 'It is time / high time' we use a past tense.
a.as: 'It is time / high time'ৰ পিছত past tense হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (went). After 'It is time / It is high time' a past tense is used with present meaning. 'Go' (B) is present, 'will go' (C) is future, and 'have gone' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (went)। 'It is time / It is high time'ৰ পিছত বৰ্তমান অৰ্থত past tense ব্যৱহাৰ হয়। 'go' (B) বৰ্তমান, 'will go' (C) ভৱিষ্যত, 'have gone' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'She talks as though she ___ (know) all the answers.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'She talks as though she ___ (know) all the answers.'

a.en: After 'as though / as if' we use the past tense for an unreal situation.
a.as: 'as though / as if'ৰ পিছত অবাস্তৱ পৰিস্থিতিত past tense হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (knew). After 'as though / as if' an unreal situation takes the past tense. 'Knows' (B) and 'know' (C) are present forms, and 'will know' (D) is future.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (knew)। 'as though / as if'ৰ পিছত অবাস্তৱ পৰিস্থিতিত past tense হয়। 'knows' (B) আৰু 'know' (C) বৰ্তমান ৰূপ, 'will know' (D) ভৱিষ্যত।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'He ___ (go) to Guwahati next month.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'He ___ (go) to Guwahati next month.'

a.en: 'Next month' is future time, so 'will + go' is used.
a.as: 'next month' ভৱিষ্যত সময়, গতিকে 'will + go' হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (will go). 'Next month' is future time, so 'will + base verb' is used. 'Goes' (B) is present, 'went' (C) is past, and 'has gone' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (will go)। 'next month' ভৱিষ্যত সময়, গতিকে 'will + মূল ক্ৰিয়া' হয়। 'goes' (B) বৰ্তমান, 'went' (C) অতীত, 'has gone' (D) present perfect।

q.en: Fill in the blank: '___ she ___ (like) black tea?'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: '___ she ___ (like) black tea?'

a.en: The interrogative of the simple present with 'she' uses 'Does + base verb'.
a.as: 'she'ৰ simple present প্ৰশ্নত 'Does + মূল ক্রিয়া' হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (Does ... like). The simple present question with 'she' uses 'Does + base verb'. 'Do ... like' (B) does not agree with 'she', 'Is ... liking' (C) wrongly uses 'like' in the continuous, and 'Did ... liked' (D) doubles the past marker.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (Does ... like)। 'she'ৰ simple present প্ৰশ্নত 'Does + মূল ক্ৰিয়া' হয়। 'Do ... like' (B) 'she'ৰ লগত মিল নাখায়, 'Is ... liking' (C)য়ে 'like' ভুলভাৱে continuousত দিছে, 'Did ... liked' (D)ত অতীত চিহ্ন দুবাৰ আছে।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'They ___ (not, come) back yet.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'They ___ (not, come) back yet.'

a.en: 'Yet' takes the present perfect negative: 'have not + past participle'.
a.as: 'yet' present perfect নেতিবাচক হয়: 'have not + past participle'।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (have not come). 'Yet' takes the present perfect negative 'have/has not + past participle'. 'Did not came' (B) and 'Do not came' (C) put a past form after 'did/do', and 'were not coming' (D) is past continuous.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (have not come)। 'yet'এ present perfect নেতিবাচক 'have/has not + past participle' লয়। 'Did not came' (B) আৰু 'Do not came' (C)য়ে 'did/do'ৰ পিছত অতীত ৰূপ দিছে, 'were not coming' (D) past continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'The children ___ (play) in the park since 4 o'clock.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'The children ___ (play) in the park since 4 o'clock.'

a.en: 'Since + point of time' with a continuing action takes the present perfect continuous.
a.as: 'since + সময় বিন্দু' আৰু চলি থকা কাৰ্য present perfect continuous হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (have been playing). 'Since + a point of time' with an action still continuing takes the present perfect continuous. 'Are playing' (B) is present continuous, 'played' (C) is past, and 'play' (D) is present simple.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (have been playing)। 'since + সময়ৰ বিন্দু' আৰু এতিয়াও চলি থকা কাৰ্যত present perfect continuous হয়। 'are playing' (B) present continuous, 'played' (C) অতীত, 'play' (D) simple present।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'I ___ (not, see) him since 2020.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'I ___ (not, see) him since 2020.'

a.en: 'Since + point of time' in a negative sense takes the present perfect negative.
a.as: 'since + সময় বিন্দু' নেতিবাচক অৰ্থত present perfect negative হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (have not seen). 'Since + a point of time' with a negative sense takes the present perfect negative 'have/has not + past participle'. 'Did not see' (B) is simple past, 'do not see' (C) is present, and 'was not seeing' (D) is past continuous.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (have not seen)। 'since + সময়ৰ বিন্দু' নেতিবাচক অৰ্থত present perfect negative 'have/has not + past participle' লয়। 'did not see' (B) simple past, 'do not see' (C) বৰ্তমান, 'was not seeing' (D) past continuous।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'We ___ (know) each other for many years.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'We ___ (know) each other for many years.'

a.en: 'For + period' up to now takes the present perfect 'have known'.
a.as: 'for + সময়' এতিয়ালৈকে present perfect 'have known' হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (have known). 'For + a period' continuing up to now takes the present perfect, and the stative verb 'know' is not used in the continuous. 'Are knowing' (B) is wrong for a stative verb, 'knew' (C) is past, and 'know' (D) is present simple.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (have known)। 'for + সময়' এতিয়ালৈকে চলি থাকিলে present perfect হয়, আৰু stative ক্ৰিয়া 'know' continuousত নহয়। 'are knowing' (B) stative ক্ৰিয়াৰ বাবে ভুল, 'knew' (C) অতীত, 'know' (D) simple present।

q.en: Fill in the blank: 'While I ___ (walk) on the road, I met an old friend.'
q.as: খালী ঠাই পূৰণ কৰক: 'While I ___ (walk) on the road, I met an old friend.'

a.en: 'While' introduces a longer background action, so the past continuous is used.
a.as: 'while'য়ে দীঘলীয়া পটভূমি কাৰ্য বুজায়, গতিকে past continuous হয়।

explanation.en: The correct option is A (was walking). 'While' introduces the longer background action, which takes the past continuous, while the shorter interrupting action ('met') stays in the simple past. 'Walked' (B) is simple past, 'walk' (C) is present, and 'have walked' (D) is present perfect.
explanation.as: শুদ্ধ উত্তৰ A (was walking)। 'while'য়ে দীঘলীয়া পটভূমি কাৰ্য বুজায়, যি past continuousত হয়, আনহাতে চুটি বাধাদানকাৰী কাৰ্য ('met') simple pastত থাকে। 'walked' (B) simple past, 'walk' (C) বৰ্তমান, 'have walked' (D) present perfect।
